assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Use all reconciliation lines. CFO-note financial expense and investment loss differ from income-statement financial expense and investment income; never substitute those equal-label but different-definition amounts. Do not replace operating working-capital changes by raw balance-sheet AR/AP changes.

assessment_table.title: 非经常性税后和归属口径

evidence.quote: 少数股东权益影响额（税后）

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: The reported nonrecurring total is after tax and parent-attributable. Subtract it from parent net income only. A group after-tax amount can be derived by adding back the reported after-tax minority effect; prior group amount remains unavailable from parent difference alone.

assessment_table.title: 其他收益、非主营分析和非经常补助不可混用
assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: The full other-income statement amount, non-main-business-analysis other income, and nonrecurring subsidies have different definitions and amounts. Do not call all government support nonrecurring or reconcile by silently dropping exclusions.

assessment_table.title: 比较列版本保留
assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Use the presented 2024H1 comparatives for like-for-like calculations and preserve their explicitly restated label. Do not silently assert original and restated versions are identical.
assessment_table.gap: Headline checklist says no retrospective restatement; detailed income/cost/selling-expense comparatives say restated. Cause not established in this read-only review; do not invent it.

evidence.quote: 期末余额 期初余额

assessment_table.title: 赊销与采购额缺口
assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: If credit sales/purchases are absent, label revenue/COGS based DSO/DPO as proxy. Disclose excluded notes receivable/payable, contract assets and financing receivables. Do not label purchase cash paid as accrual purchases.
assessment_table.gap: Selected statements do not give matched credit-sales or accrual-purchases totals. Finance-leasing receivables are material outside ordinary trade AR.

evidence.quote: （3） 不属于现金及现金等价物的货币资金

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Reconcile cash scope exactly. For EV to equity explicitly choose cash available/excess cash; do not add gross monetary funds and separately add cash equivalents. Neither reported balance is automatically excess cash.

assessment_table.title: 租赁负债流动部分避免双计

evidence.quote: 一年内到期的租赁负债

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Either use total lease liability once, or current+noncurrent once. Do not use note gross total then add current again. FCFF/EBIT/leases treatment must use a consistent policy.

assessment_table.title: 净债务和其他价值桥接

evidence.quote: 一年内到期的长期应付职工薪酬

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Build an explicit bridge ledger; current noncurrent-liability aggregate contains mixed debt/lease/benefit items and must not be added to its already included components. Cash, NCI and non-operating assets each enter once. Book NCI is not automatically market NCI; 2025-06 balances do not become FY-end balances without assumptions.

assessment_table.title: 股数、回购与可转债稀释

evidence.quote: 本报告期内，可转换公司债券余额因转
基本每股收益（元/股） 稀释每股收益（元/股）

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Date and share basis must be explicit. Issued shares, weighted-average EPS denominator, outstanding shares and fully diluted shares differ. The cited repurchase count is one program, not proof of all treasury shares. If assuming conversion, do not both subtract converted debt and dilute shares as if debt remained.
assessment_table.gap: FY-end share count and future conversion/repurchase decisions remain assumptions. Do not reverse engineer a precise share count from rounded EPS.

assessment_table.title: 资本开支及DCF现金流定义

evidence.quote: 购建固定资产、无形资产和其他长期资产支付的现金

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Separate operating capex from investment cash outflow/acquisitions. CFO minus capex is a named cash-flow proxy, not automatically FCFF. D&A/lease policy, interest/tax adjustment and future reinvestment must be explicit.

assessment_table.title: 制造业等效量模型的业务范围

evidence.quote: 本公司的经营业务划分为四个经营分部
租赁业务分部：融资租赁及经营租赁业务。

assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: The consolidated group includes machinery, prestress and lease activities. An aggregate manufacturing scenario must state the equivalent-unit simplification and the treatment of financial/leasing activity. It is not a measured single-product shipment forecast.

assessment_table.title: 原料敞口、提价、弹性、传导时滞
assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Observed segment growth/gross margin does not establish material exposure, elasticity, pass-through rate or lag. Any unsubstantiated quantitative value is a research assumption with rationale and sensitivity, not disclosure.
assessment_table.gap: No source-backed numerical mapping from one input material shock to whole-group margin has been established in the reviewed evidence. R&D material expense is not production material exposure.

assessment_table.title: 同行可比估值仍缺资料
assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Require dated peer prices/caps, share/debt/cash and matched earnings or EBITDA period/scope, including EV/equity bridge. Negative denominator is not a normal multiple.
assessment_table.gap: Stage1 archived only one issuer PDF and no peer valuation source artifact. This independent review cannot mark PE or EV/EBITDA as completed.

assessment_table.title: 首轮应用尚未产出计算成果
assessment_table.acceptance_requirement: Independent source facts and formulas are preparation, not proof that the application used them correctly. Compare actual saved inputs/results only after the authorised continuation.
assessment_table.gap: The first run ended at the 24-tool cap with zero research artifacts. One successful subtraction is correct but does not establish a complete quality model or valuation.

runner_verification.limit_policy: Only remaining budget is sent to the new group. Operator waiting time is excluded. Runtime settings are checked, never changed by runner. Actual live settings/model execution not rechecked in this offline review.
runner_verification.observer_failure_caveat: If observer fails before the stage is appended, finally currently takes only the last completed stage for cumulative usage. The saved active_run/raw audit must be used to reconcile any partial continuation spend; do not interpret missing continuation_usage as zero.

limitations: This is an independent acceptance reference, not an application run or successful accuracy benchmark.
Only specified accounting/valuation boundaries and selected related source fields have been reviewed; it is not a full 199-page accounting audit.
Values are stated at original CNY precision; ratio decimals are presentation only and exact Fractions are retained.
No peer prices, forward FY2025 facts, production exposure or price elasticities have been invented.
